title: Analytic order of a product of nonzero dilations
statement: Let w be any natural number, let ζ be a nonzero complex number, and let A : ℂ → ℂ be analytic at zero with analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤. Define P(t) = ∏_{j=0}^{w−1} A(ζ^j t), interpreting an empty product as 1. Then P is analytic at zero, analyticOrderAt P 0 ≠ ⊤, and analyticOrderNatAt P 0 = w · analyticOrderNatAt A 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ), ζ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤ → let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => ∏ j ∈ Finset.range w, A (ζ ^ j * t); AnalyticAt ℂ P 0 ∧ analyticOrderAt P 0 ≠ ⊤ ∧ analyticOrderNatAt P 0 = w * analyticOrderNatAt A 0
